verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an Angular Language Service or editor-integration feature providing autocompletion/type-checking; the only related comment (angular-comm-3) states that Angular's template-as-string approach prevented editors from doing intellisense, tag matching, or catching typos at compile time, which is the opposite of what the story asks for. No corroborating evidence shows this capability actually being delivered.
